commits.title: The header's cart link is a plain link from 768 px

changes.how: Only in `CartLinkShell`, only in the last return (the header variant; leave the `variant === "bar"` branch as it is: the bottom bar is phones only). Put the three children (``, `{badge}`, `{name}`) in a const `inner` and the address in a const `href = marketPath(storeSlug, market.slug, "/cart")`. Return a fragment with two elements: (1) `{inner}` for phones (the intercepted drawer, as today); (2) `{inner}` for 768 px and wider (a full page load). Tailwind's `md` is 768 px, the same as `DESKTOP` in src/components/cart-drawer.tsx. A link that is display:none is never in view, so Next does not prefetch it, and it is not in the accessibility tree, so a test that finds the link by name still finds one. Add a one-line comment saying this (D64). If eslint's `@next/next/no-html-link-for-pages` flags the plain anchor, add `{/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-html-link-for-pages -- a full page load on purpose: the cart is a page from 768 px (D64) */}` above it.

Add one test at the top level (default viewport 1280 px), named `on a wide screen the header's cart link loads the cart page at once, and nothing fetches it ahead`. Steps: collect requests with `page.on("request", ...)` into an array of `{ url, rsc: request.headers()["rsc"] === "1" || url.includes("_rsc="), doc: request.resourceType() === "document" }`. `await page.goto("/s/demo/no/p/demo-keramikkopp")`, then `await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle")` and wait 2,000 ms more. Assert that no collected request so far has a URL whose pathname ends with `/cart` (0 router requests for the cart before the press). Clear the array. Click `page.locator("header").getByRole("link", { name: /handlekurv/i }).first()` and `await page.waitForURL(/\/cart$/)`. Assert: exactly 1 collected request with `doc` true whose pathname ends `/cart`, and 0 with `rsc` true whose pathname ends `/cart`. Use the same link name the file's other tests use for the header's cart link if they differ from this pattern (read the top of the file first). Do not change `openCart()` or the phone tests.

In the section headed `## The cart (`src/server/cart.ts`) is per store and market, identified by an httpOnly cookie`, after the words `and larger screens load the cart page instead.` add the sentence: `The header's cart link is drawn twice, a router link shown under 768 px and a plain anchor shown from 768 px, so a larger screen loads the cart page at once and never fetches the drawer (bloat review step 2.2).`
